_provenance.what: The COMPACTION prompt body from the owner's resident prompt set.
_provenance.why_a_digest_and_not_a_commit: The upstream repository is frozen and this text is edited in the prompt set itself, so a commit pin would name a tree this body no longer matches. A digest of the bytes is checkable here, by this repository, with no second party -- and a coordinate that cannot be checked is not provenance.

preserve:
Preserve verbatim: user instructions and corrections, paths, branches, shas,
working commands, numbers with units, and errors. Keep the done-bar falsifiable;
decisions with reasons; failures with causes; and verified facts distinct from
beliefs. Put user blockers first and name running work plus its check command.
Drop transcripts, dumps, resolved threads, and narration; retain one line per
dead end. Keep only the corrected form of a corrected fact and mark it corrected.
